         )

+
+    def test_radioselect_no_empty_label(self):
+        """RadioSelect should not include an empty choice."""
+        class ModelChoiceForm(forms.Form):
+            category = forms.ModelChoiceField(Category.objects.all(), widget=forms.RadioSelect)
+
+        form = ModelChoiceForm()
+        html = str(form['category'])
+        # The blank "---------" option must NOT appear in RadioSelect output.
+        self.assertNotIn('value=""', html)
+        self.assertNotIn('---------', html)
+
+    def test_radioselect_with_required_false_no_empty_label(self):
+        """RadioSelect with required=False should also not include an empty choice."""
+        class ModelChoiceForm(forms.Form):
+            category = forms.ModelChoiceField(
+                Category.objects.all(), widget=forms.RadioSelect, required=False,
+            )
+
+        form = ModelChoiceForm()
+        html = str(form['category'])
+        self.assertNotIn('value=""', html)
+        self.assertNotIn('---------', html)
+
+    def test_select_still_has_empty_label(self):
+        """Select widget should still include empty label for required fields."""
+        class ModelChoiceForm(forms.Form):
+            category = forms.ModelChoiceField(Category.objects.all(), widget=forms.Select)
+
+        form = ModelChoiceForm()
+        html = str(form['category'])
+        self.assertIn('value=""', html)
+        self.assertIn('---------', html)
+
+    def test_radioselect_with_initial_no_empty_label(self):
+        """RadioSelect with initial value should not include empty choice."""
+        c1 = Category.objects.first()
+        class ModelChoiceForm(forms.Form):
+            category = forms.ModelChoiceField(
+                Category.objects.all(), widget=forms.RadioSelect, initial=c1,
+            )
+
+        form = ModelChoiceForm()
+        html = str(form['category'])
+        self.assertNotIn('value=""', html)
+        # The selected option should be the initial value.
+        self.assertIn('checked', html)
+
+    def test_modelform_radioselect_no_empty_label(self):
+        """ModelForm with RadioSelect widget should not include empty choice."""
+        from .models import Award, Character
+
+        class AwardForm(forms.ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = Award
+                fields = ['character']
+                widgets = {'character': forms.RadioSelect()}
+
+        form = AwardForm()
+        html = str(form['character'])
+        # blank=False on the FK means no empty choice for RadioSelect.
+        self.assertNotIn('value=""', html)
+        self.assertNotIn('---------', html)
+
+    def test_modelform_select_still_has_empty_label(self):
+        """ModelForm with Select widget should still include empty label."""
+        from .models import Award, Character
+
+        class AwardForm(forms.ModelForm):
+            class Meta:
+                model = Award
+                fields = ['character']
+                widgets = {'character': forms.Select()}
+
+        form = AwardForm()
+        html = str(form['character'])
+        self.assertIn('value=""', html)
+        self.assertIn('---------', html)
